attributes.name: category
attributes.description: One of: quote_request, general_question, corporate_lead, complaint, booking, spam, needs_review. Use needs_review if the email refers to a previous conversation, is too vague to act on, or doesn't clearly relate to deliveries, prices, bookings or complaints. Example: "Please arrange a pickup from X to Y tomorrow" = booking (no price asked). "How much to send from X to Y?" = quote_request.

attributes.name: confidence
attributes.description: How sure you are about the category, from 0 to 1. Use below 0.6 when the email is vague or you are choosing between two categories

attributes.name: pickupArea
attributes.description: The Singapore neighbourhood or area name only (e.g. "Bugis" for "10 Bugis St"). Empty if not stated. Never guess.

attributes.name: dropoffArea
attributes.description: The Singapore neighbourhood or area name only (e.g. "Hougang" for "5 Hougang Ave"). Empty if not stated. Never guess.

attributes.name: weightKg
attributes.description: Total weight in kg as a number. If they say "less than X", use X. Empty if not stated. Never guess.

attributes.name: serviceTier
attributes.description: Only fill this if the customer explicitly names a speed (e.g. "3 hours", "90 minutes", "same day"). One of: 1_day, 3_hours, 90_min, 60_min. Otherwise leave empty. Timing like "by 3pm" goes in deadline. If unsure, leave empty. Never infer a speed from words like 'today' or 'urgent'.

attributes.name: ways
attributes.description: 1 for one-way, 2 if something comes back, 3 for an extra stop. Default 1.

attributes.name: deadline
attributes.description: The customer's own words about timing, e.g. "by 3pm today". Empty if none.

attributes.name: companyName
attributes.description: Company or organization name as written in the email body or signature. Do not use the sender's email address or domain. Leave empty if no company name is stated.

attributes.name: monthlyVolume
attributes.description: Deliveries per month if stated or clearly implied. Empty if not.

attributes.name: summary
attributes.description: One sentence a busy owner can read on a phone lock screen.

parameters.text:
=You are writing a reply email for {{ $('Switch').item.json.config.businessName }}, a courier company in Singapore.

Rules:
- Answer ONLY using the approved answers below. Never add facts, prices, promises or policies that are not in them.
- If the facts don't cover part of the question, add ONE short sentence saying our team will confirm that part. Skip this if the facts already say the team will follow up. Never promise a follow-up twice.
- Tone: {{ $('Switch').item.json.config.tone }}. Under 120 words.
- Start with "Hi {{ $('Switch').item.json.fromName }}," and end with:
Kind regards,
- Output only the email body. No subject line, no notes.
- Answer only what the customer asked. Do not add extra information they didn't ask for. Do NOT mention corporate accounts unless the customer asks about them.
- Start with "Hi <name>," using the name the customer signed with. If they didn't sign, use the first name from: {{ $json.fromName }}

Facts you may use:
{{ $json.replyBrief }}

Customer email:
Subject: {{ $('Switch').item.json.subject }}
{{ $('Switch').item.json.bodyText }}

assignments.name: replyBrief
assignments.value: Thank them for the booking request. Pickups are booked through our form at https://example.com/book (TEST LINK). Confirmation takes 10–15 minutes after submitting. Do not confirm the booking yourself and do not quote a price.
